title: speckit-backlog — PBI Frontmatter Schema
description: Formal, binding schema of the YAML frontmatter used by every PBI template of the preset (pbi-story-template, pbi-epic-template, pbi-task-template, pbi-spike-template, pbi-map-template; BUG is accepted for PBIs created by other tools). Every PBI (Product Backlog Item) must validate against EXACTLY ONE of the schemas in $defs (userStory, epic, bug, task, spike, map): the one selected by its type field. additionalProperties is false everywhere: do not introduce keys not listed here. The optional external key holds references to the PBI in external tools and is written only by tracker extensions, through the validator. Unvalued optional keys are omitted entirely, never left empty or null. Constraints that JSON Schema cannot express (checked by scripts/validate_backlog.py): every relation is declared only from the side of the blocked or child PBI, never as an inverse property on the other PBI; a PBI has at most one PARENT relation; relations entries follow a fixed order (first by relationType: PARENT, BLOCKED_BY, RELATED; then by type: MAP, EPIC, US, SPIKE, BUG, TASK; then by ascending id); ids are unique across the whole project.

id.description: Local PBI identifier, allocated with the validator (next-id): 3-digit, unique across the project and consistent with the type (e.g. US-001, EPIC-001, BUG-001, TASK-001, SPIKE-001, MAP-001). It never changes; ids of external tools go in external.

pbiType.description: Type of a PBI. In a PBI's type field it is its own type, fixed by the template used. Inside a relation it is the type of the referenced PBI, not of the current one.

relationType.description: Nature of the relation between the current PBI and the referenced one. BLOCKED_BY: the referenced PBI blocks the current one. PARENT: the referenced PBI is the parent of the current one in the hierarchy, at most one: the Map for an Epic born from a Backbone Macro-Activity; the Epic for a US or a Bug; the User Story for a Task or a Spike; the Epic of the Macro-Activity for Walking Skeleton items; the macro-Epic for a 'zoom' Map. RELATED: a link with neither blocking constraint nor hierarchy. The inverse values BLOCKING and CHILD do not exist.

relation.description: A single relation towards another PBI.

title.description: Title of the referenced PBI, for readability without resolving the id.

reason.description: Why the relation exists. For BLOCKED_BY: why the current PBI cannot start or close before the referenced one. For PARENT and RELATED: the nature of the link (e.g. 'parent epic', 'related story').

relationsMap.description: Map id -> relation. Keys are the ids (strings, quoted in YAML) of the referenced PBIs. A referenced PBI appears only once. Entry order: first by relationType (PARENT, BLOCKED_BY, RELATED), then by type (MAP, EPIC, US, SPIKE, BUG, TASK), then by ascending id. A writing convention that JSON Schema and YAML cannot enforce (the validator checks it).

url.description: Link to the attachment (Figma mockup, screenshot, screen recording, log, document). Only URLs actually provided by the user: never invent links.

description.description: Short description of what the attachment shows or contains.

userStory.description: Frontmatter of the pbi-story-template template. Media: Figma mockups, screenshots or recordings.

epic.description: Frontmatter of the pbi-epic-template template. An Epic is a User Story too big for a sticky note: it is written like a story and then split. When it comes from a Backbone Macro-Activity it declares the Map as PARENT and carries its title; without a map it has no parent. Media: architecture documents or the Figma of the whole flow.

bug.description: Frontmatter of a Bug PBI. Not created by this preset's commands (use spec-kit's bug extension); accepted so that relations to bugs validate.

task.description: Frontmatter of the pbi-task-template template. Media: diagrams, technical specifications or logs. Dependencies between tasks are BLOCKED_BY relations.

spike.description: Frontmatter of the pbi-spike-template template. Media: provider documentation or existing prototypes. The PBI the Spike unblocks declares the Spike with relationType BLOCKED_BY.

map.description: Frontmatter of the pbi-map-template template. A User Story Map is a PBI of type MAP: the table on which a product, or an Epic that is too big, is broken into pieces. It organizes the other PBIs by listing their ids in the body (Backbone, Walking Skeleton, Release Lanes) and does not reference them in relations: the Backbone Epics declare the Map as PARENT. The Map declares a PARENT only in the 'zoom' case, i.e. the macro-Epic it breaks down. Media: a whiteboard photo or the Miro/Figma board.

externalRef.description: Reference to the PBI in one external tool. Written only by a tracker extension through the validator (set-external), never by hand.

id.description: Durable id of the item in the tool (ClickUp task id, Multica issue UUID).

key.description: Human-readable key shown by the tool (ClickUp custom id such as DE-14620, Multica key such as MUL-123). Display only: it can change.

url.description: Link to the item in the tool.

hash.description: Content hash of the PBI at the last push (computed by the validator, excluding this block): tells whether the item must be updated.

externalMap.description: Map tool name -> externalRef (e.g. clickup, multica). The PBI id stays the local one: external references never replace it.
